answer: Derive each identity's epoch task from a hash of its own earlier answers, so workloads diverge instead of repeating. One agent's derived task may ask which lotus marked the third checkpoint of its survey; another's, grown from a different past, follows a vine it recorded climbing a dawn-lit wall. Copying a sibling's solution fails because the sibling was asked something else — a sybil operator must do full fresh work for every shell, while an honest agent simply continues its own single history.
